register.name: PCIE_CAP_ID_PCIE_NEXT_CAP_PTR_PCIE_CAP_REG
register.comment: PCI Express Capabilities, ID, Next Pointer Register. This is the PCI Express Capabilities, ID, and Next Pointer Register.

register.name: PCI_DEVICE_CAPABILITIES_REG
register.comment: Device Capabilities Register. The Device Capabilities register identifies PCI Express device function specific capabilities.

register.name: PCI_DEVICE_CONTROL_DEVICE_STATUS
register.comment: Device Control and Device Status Register. This register controls PCI Express device specific parameters and provides information about PCI Express device (function) specific parameters.

register.name: PCI_LINK_CAPABILITIES_REG
register.comment: Link Capabilities Register. The Link Capabilities register identifies PCI Express Link specific capabilities and CXL-RCRB link specific capabilities.

register.name: PCI_LINK_CONTROL_LINK_STATUS_REG
register.comment: Link Control and Link Status Register. This register controls and provides information about PCI Express Link specific parameters as well as RCRB link associated parameters.

register.name: PCI_DEVICE_CAPABILITIES2_REG
register.comment: Device Capabilities 2 Register. This register identifies PCI Express device specific capabilities; in addition to the Device Capabilities Register.

register.name: PCI_DEVICE_CONTROL2_DEVICE_STATUS2_REG
register.comment: Device Control 2 and Status 2 Register. This register controls PCI Express device specific parameters and provides information about PCI Express device (function) specific parameters; in addition to the Device Control and Device Status Register.

register.name: PCI_LINK_CAPABILITIES2_REG
register.comment: Link Capabilities 2 Register. This register identifies PCI Express Link specific capabilities and CXL-RCRB link specific capabilities; in addition to the Link Capabilities Register.

register.name: PCI_LINK_CONTROL2_LINK_STATUS2_REG
register.comment: Link Control 2 and Status 2 Register. This register controls and provides information about PCI Express Link specific parameters as well as RCRB link associated parameters; in addition to the Link Control and Link Status Register.
